sourceComparison.keeper/keeper.ts: Publishes chainId, keeperGas, lastLoop, loopError, and fillCost. fillCost is a conservative configured estimate of 470000 gas at the fee cap.
sourceComparison.web/lib/api.ts: Status types lastLoop, loopError, keeperGas, and fillCost.
sourceComparison.web/app/Watch.tsx: Heartbeat displays stale at age >=15 seconds and computes whole sales from keeperGas/fillCost.
sourceComparison.docs/feature-matrix.md: Rows 1 and 2 updated with this live and isolated-fixture evidence.
sourceComparison.measurementNote: Receipt-derived conservative cost uses transaction gas limit multiplied by maxFeePerGas. Receipt gasUsed and actual receipt cost are recorded separately. Both measured and configured conservative runway floor to 99 fills.
